newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: At least two killed in Bogota prison riot.
newsitem.headline: At least two killed in Bogota prison riot.

text.p: At least two inmates were killed and 17 injured in a riot early on Thursday at Bogota's Modelo prison, authorities said.

Metropolitan Police commander Gen. Teodoro Campo, speaking in a telephone interview with Reuters from inside the prison, denied local news reports that as many as nine prisoners were killed when guards moved to quell an uprising inside the ageing prison facility that began shortly before midnight Wednesday.
"We have identified two dead so far and we think there are two others based on information we have received from some of the inmates," Campo said.
"The number of injured has been officially confirmed, there were 17 people injured," he added.

Prisoners inside the Modelo, who contacted local radio stations, said at least nine of their fellow inmates were indiscriminately gunned down by guards who moved at about 2 a.m. (0700 GMT) to put down what they described as a "peaceful protest."
But Campo insisted that no more than four people were killed and said the cause of the violence was still under investigation.
At least a dozen bloody riots against poor living conditions and human rights violations have erupted so far this year in Colombia's prisons, which are notoriously overcrowded and violent.
